LanguageData.VGE_GravshipBombardmentTargeter.label: gravship bombardment targeter
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipBombardmentTargeter.descript: A compact targeting apparatus tuned to interface with gravship artillery systems. When activated, it designates a ground position and transmits firing coordinates to a linked gravship turret within range. The turret will automatically fire on the marked location. After a short cooldown, the targeter can be used again.
